blocks.text: AIA Philippines, formerly Philam Life, has launched AIA Advantage Max, a one-time premium investment-linked insurance product that brings together life insurance protection and access to global investment opportunities, including the potential for quarterly dividend payouts. Available in both Philippine peso and US dollar denominations, Advantage Max is designed for individuals looking to grow and potentially generate global income from their wealth without compromising on protection. Through the Global Dynamic Income Paying Fund (GDIF), with a historical annualized payout rate of over 6%, and the new Global Adventurous Income Fund (GAIF), targeting a 7% annualized payout rate, customers can access professionally managed […]...
